title: Marguerite and the Winter
author: Petra Whitlock
blurb: Sable Yarrow, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, has spent seven years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must finish the ritual the founders started before the well refills.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
